QuestInfo.name: A Gift from Shingen
QuestInfo.0: Takeda Shingen is looking for you. What could he need?
QuestInfo.1: The Takeda clan wanted to get you a present for all your help, but Shingen is terrible at buying gifts. He thought Kikkawa Motoharu might have something for you.
QuestInfo.2: Shingen granted you permission to use his favorite horse, Onikageh. The beast is treasured for being the best of its breed, so treat it well.

0.0: Hey Hayato, you're looking tough as a wild boar. I've got to tell you, I've been impressed with the gumption you've got. You're a real stand-up kind of samurai.
0.1: I just, aw geez do I hate this kind of mushy nonsense. Look, I got you something. Don't get all emotional on me and start expecting 'handshakes' or 'pleasantries'. It's just because you did a good job. Only, it's not exactly done.
0.2: I need to find the right harness for the job, and frankly I don't feel comfortable asking another warrior for their clothing sizes. Are you up for a little shopping?

yes.0: No samurai ever turns down presents. It's the first line in the bushido code book... I think. Go talk to Kikkawa Motoharu and see if you can get fitted for a nice harness.

no.0: I promise it's a great gift, it's just not a complete great gift.

1.0: Did you find a worthy harness?

yes.0: Wow, that is one fine harness you got! Those red details would really light up my mane... maybe I'll go get one for myself later.
yes.1: Oh, I'm forgetting myself. I, lord of all that is mighty and strong, present you with the Onikageh, the greatest horse in all of the Takeda Cavalry. It is a symbol of our proud heritage.
yes.2: You've treated us like family. You've fought for us, you've bled for us, now you will ride like us. May Onikageh serve you well.

item.0: A rider must use the best quality items available. Otherwise, you put your life on the line.
